title: GTM SE/CSM account sync — scratchpad
content:
Purpose / why I want this 1:1:
- Align SE (Liam) + CSM (Maya) on renewal posture and Q2 expansion plan.
- Surface product risks (latency spikes, embedding recall) and decide whether to schedule a joint engineering deep-dive.
- Agree on next 6 weeks success milestones we can show the exec sponsor.

Quick background (one-liners to set context):
- Northstar started on Redwood hosted API in Oct 2025; moved to Dedicated trial in Jan 2026 for predictable throughput during PoC.
- Current usage: ~120M tokens / month, spiky during nightly jobs; they are evaluating Dedicated commit vs Private for compliance.
- Exec sponsor: Priya Rao (VP Data Products) — main concern: predictable latency for real-time features and cost per inference.

Meeting objectives (3 priorities):
1) Confirm renewal likelihood and ask for commit runway (target: draft letter of intent by 2026-03-31).
2) Decide on action: immediate eng triage (SRE + serving-runtime) vs monitoring/observability improvements.
3) Land a clear expansion next-step (pilot for reranking on 3 additional pipelines, rollout plan).

Proposed 20m agenda (keep tight):
- 00:00–02:00 quick sync / state check
- 02:00–08:00 technical risk review (Liam) — latency trends, KV cache hit rates, recent incidents
- 08:00–14:00 business ask + renewal posture (Maya) — pricing sensitivity, exec timeline
- 14:00–18:00 next steps + owners: who does what by when
- 18:00–20:00 close / prep for customer-facing notes

Signals and red flags to call out (say these plainly):
- Repeated latency spikes > 500ms for tail percentiles during peak (affects feature X); if not resolved within 2 weeks, renewal risk increases.
- Embedded search recall dipped 6% MoM after quantized rollout (they noticed drift in relevance).
- Legal compliance decision leaning to on-prem could push timeline by 6–12 weeks (cost to us: delayed revenue and additional engineering effort).

Data points to have on hand:
- 7d and 30d latency p50/p95/p99 (per-route) — bring screenshots from Console.
- Token usage by pipeline + cost delta between hosted/dedicated/private for their volume (rough order of magnitude).
- Incident timeline and RCA draft for the Feb 28th degradation (link in artifacts).

Scripts / phrasing (soft, but clear):
- "We want to make the renewal as frictionless as possible — can we align on a preliminary commitment by month-end so we can lock capacity for your peak windows?"
- If they push on price: "If price is the main blocker, we can model a commit that reduces unit cost while keeping a safety buffer for bursts — can I take that back to pricing and run a scenario for you?"
- On latency issues: "We own this problem — quick triage now, and if needed a dedicated follow-up with our serving runtime team within 72 hours. Which outcome would you prefer?"

Open questions for the SE to answer (for the meeting):
- Are the latency spikes correlated with a specific model or route? (Liam to confirm)
- Is prefix caching configured for the nightly job pipelines? If not, how fast to enable?
- Can we produce a deterministic repro for the Feb 28 incident within 24 hours?

Escalation path (if sponsor asks for higher-touch):
- Step 1: Strawman SLA commitments from Dedicated team + temporary burst capacity for 2 weeks.
- Step 2: Schedule a joint tech deep-dive with serving-runtime and SRE (owner: Liam) within 5 business days.
- Step 3: Assign a named Solutions Engineer for rollout support (owner: Maya).

Materials to share after the call:
- One-page TL;DR: renewal ask, open risks, next steps (I will draft).
- 4-slide tech appendix (Liam) with latency charts + quick fixes.
- Updated account plan in Confluence and a proposed LoI template.

Rough negotiation levers to propose (if we need to move):
- 6–9 month Dedicated commit with a lower unit price + 10% burst buffer for first 60 days.
- Conditional pricing adjustment if they adopt prefix/KV caching config recommended by our team within 30 days.
- Optional professional services block (20 days) for private deploy readiness, billed separately.

Follow-up notes template (post-call):
- Subject: Northstar — sync recap + next steps
- 1-line summary: where we landed on renewal posture
- Action table: owner / task / due date (I will populate then share)
- Request: ask for exec meeting week of Mar 29 to finalize LoI

Risks I am comfortable owning now (Maya):
- Coordinate exec scheduling + commercial ask
- Draft LoI and run pricing scenarios with finance

Tech owner commitments (Liam):
- Provide per-route p99 deltas and caching enablement plan
- Lead triage and set up engineering deep-dive if triage indicates systemic regression

Hidden asks I want to surface to SE before the call:
- Could we precompute a cost delta table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) for their exact token mix? That will shorten negotiation time.
- Quick checklist for enabling prefix/KV caching safely in their staging cluster.

Notes to self (personal reminders):
- Be explicit about deadlines — executives respond to calendar dates, not vague "soon".
- Post-call: write the TL;DR within 2 hours while context is fresh.
- If they push on legal/compliance: escalate to Private deployment lead and set expectation around timeline.

Appendix: quick bullets for meeting close
- "We will draft an LoI by 2026-03-31 for your review."
- "Liam, please own the triage and deliver p99 by 2026-03-16."
- "I will run pricing scenarios and propose 2 committed options by 2026-03-18."
action_items: Liam Chen: deliver per-route latency p50/p95/p99 charts by 2026-03-16
Maya Patel: draft LoI + 2 pricing scenarios and share with Finance by 2026-03-18
Jordan Hayes: schedule joint tech deep-dive (serving-runtime + SRE) if triage requires; target within 5 business days
Maya Patel: send post-call TL;DR and updated Confluence account plan within 2 hours after meeting
Liam Chen: prepare 4-slide tech appendix (latency + KV caching plan) before call
